title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Dark Exhibition Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Dark Exhibition Room
options.lineage: dim gallery with lit exhibits; watch and perfume counters
options.thesis: One deep green-black room, and in it the two apps lit like exhibits; choosing one floods the room with its colour.
materials: pale lit phone screens built in HTML
options.viewport: Centred slightly above the midline, one phone showing Macro, lit, about a third of the width; the name AJAL as a very wide low wordmark under it; one sentence; one pale button: Email me. A Macro / Cradle switch beside the phone swaps the exhibit and the room's accent.
options.risk: Dark developer portfolios are common; this one must stay a room with lit objects, never black with a neon glow.

raised.raise: The figures (100K+ people, 4.9 rating, 1.9M foods) are lit objects: large, bright, rolling into place once.
Selection floods the readouts: picking Macro or Cradle recolours the room's accent and every readout at once.
The career is one continuous ruled timeline with year stamps, not a list of cards.
On a phone the exhibits unroll as stacked, synchronised bands, one per screen.

options.label: The Nutrition Facts Label
options.lineage: the black-ruled nutrition facts panel on every food package, Macro's own print artefact
options.thesis: Ajal set as a facts label: serving size one engineer, apps shipped, people served, with heavy black rules and bold weights doing the hierarchy.
options.viewport: A tall label fills the left half: AJAL P in heavy type, then rows: Companies co-founded 2, People using his apps 100K+, Average rating 4.9. Right half holds a Macro phone. Email me is the one red element.
options.risk: The label is a joke the visitor gets once; it reads as a gimmick on a second visit, and it is the direction most runs for a nutrition-app founder would land on.

options.label: Nixie Laboratory Counter
options.thesis: Every number on the page as a glowing stacked digit in a glass tube.
options.viewport: Banks of tubes counting users, ratings and apps; the name engraved below.
options.case: Hiring managers do not identify with lab instruments, and the glow is the exact look the brief forbids.
options.kept: Quantities as the interface; the figures become lit objects.
options.risk: Reads as a retro gadget, not a person.

options.label: Anti-aliased Racing League
options.thesis: Each app as a liveried craft whose colour floods the page on hover.
options.viewport: Two liveried craft racing left to right; hover floods the readouts.
options.case: Loud livery and sponsor decals contradict a minimal brief and say nothing a hiring manager needs.
options.kept: Selection floods the readouts with the chosen item's colour.

options.label: Rain-night Cityscape
options.thesis: The career as a skyline passing from blue hour to dawn.
options.case: No city belongs to this product; the neon lettering is the forbidden glow.
options.kept: Stacked synchronised bands on a phone.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.lineage: architectural section drawings with sun paths
options.thesis: The page as one long building section with time stamps.
options.viewport: A ruled section; annotations pinned to sun angles.
options.case: Beautiful but about buildings; a hiring manager would not place a software engineer in it.
options.kept: One continuous ruled timeline with stamps.

options.label: Torn Flyer Wall
options.lineage: club walls of stapled photocopied flyers
options.thesis: The career as layers of torn flyers.
options.case: Punk flyer energy contradicts a minimal, modern brief and says nothing about shipping apps.
options.kept: Exposed layers stay open as a record.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Content as cloth courses stepping under one window.
options.viewport: A single window; courses snap one step.
options.case: A monitoring surface grammar; a portfolio has nothing to monitor.
options.kept: Changes snap one step and settle, never glide.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The developer portfolio everyone ships: white page, name, one line, a grid of project cards, a skills list, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and one sentence at the top, a button, project cards below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other candidate's site.
